item.title: Grand Canyon Rim-to-Rim: A Photographer’s Guide to Hiking and Shooting Both Rims
item.description: A week hiking from the North Rim to the South Rim with a camera on my back — itinerary, the best light and gear, where to shoot sunrise and sunset, rim-to-rim permits and water, and what the fire left on the North Rim.
